english.title: Drive motor vehicle in the Blackwall / Silvertown Tunnel areas at less than ten miles per hour
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTOR VEHICLE..) in the

(A)_[Blackwall]_
(B)_[Silvertown]_

tunnel area, drove at a speed of less than ten miles per hour
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 7(16) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) It is not an offence to drive less than ten miles per hour where the driver is prevented from driving at or above ten miles per hour on account of the traffic flow.
(ii) It is not an offence to drive less than ten miles per hour when directed by and authorised person to do so.
